working_directory: canonical repository root in Ubuntu-24.04 WSL

result.angular_rule: interval Riemann enclosures over every subinterval of [0,2/3]
result.scope: Scalar radial inequality fails at rho=1/2. The explicit angular-closure correction makes this one profile coefficient negative. Finite Gram controls support the written algebraic lemma; they are not its unrestricted proof. No full-rho Gaussian partition theorem is asserted.

certified_scope: At rho=1/2, the exact bounded mean-zero test f=e^(-t)+2e^(-16t)-21/34 violates the scalar positive radial inequality, and the explicit angular-closure correction makes its quadratic coefficient strictly negative.
analytic_scope: The all-profile Gram bound and coupled angular inequality are written proofs in DG6; their finite rational controls are not an unrestricted verification. DG7 uses the uniform local expansion of that written bound plus the certified negative coefficient.
arithmetic_scope: All infinite radial integrals are reduced analytically to closed quadrant formulas. Arb encloses every angular integrand on each of 8192 intervals, at 100-bit precision; no sampled angular rule or omitted radial tail is used.
limits: This refutes a sufficient scalar operator estimate, not Gaussian simplex optimality. The comparison at rho=1/2 is restricted to sufficiently small multiples of the explicit circular-mass profile. The unrestricted all-positive-correlation target remains open.
